title: Why Do Lungs Matter?
hook: Lungs take in oxygen and send out carbon dioxide.
narration: Lungs take in oxygen and send out carbon dioxide.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do Lungs Matter.
Air tubes branch like a tree inside.
Let me show you that in 3D.
The tiny ends swap gases with blood.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
Breathing is that swap, all day.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Lungs take in oxygen and send out carbon dioxide.
The pictures today are a new heart world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do lungs matter.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
